name: PROTOCOL AI ARMORED FORCE
author: Biden
scope: High-priority evaluation of the complete AI armoured-force and vehicle-engagement scope. Select complementary improvements and merge intent into current CBE ground-vehicle and combined-arms FSMs; not an automatic wholesale port.
identityEvidence: Installed mod.cpp identifies name/author and describes an armoured-force vehicle AI engagement overhaul. meta.cpp publishedid is0; supplied URL and installation folder identify the Workshop item. Web page unavailable.
evaluationTopics: Review all readable AI source and actual call paths before claiming individual capabilities.
Assess engagement selection, weapon/ammunition use, crew roles, threat prioritisation, movement and cooperation where present.
Compare useful methods with existing CBE vehicle suppression, direct fire, manoeuvre, driving and combined-arms ownership; avoid competing controllers.
Respect mission skill/fire orders, native knowledge, friendly safety, locality, interruption and repeat-safe cleanup.
Record unique strengths, selected/reworked/rejected methods, balance and bounded execution cost.
sourceProtection: Installed originals, extracts and archives remain protected read-only inputs; no raw source in product packages.
masterLedger: Historical LOCAL_IMPLEMENTATION_LEDGER.md absent; preserve intake separately for reconciliation.
acceptance: No implementation/parity/physical acceptance claimed; audits PAUSED.

sourceReview.scope: Entire readable SQF payload plus addon info; config.bin present but registration/dependencies not decoded.
observedIntent: Fire smoke through a crewed turret, then move toward nearby cover.
Recognise selected ATGM names with available magazines and request ATGM plus ordinary vehicle fire.
Short fire cooldowns and intermittent relocation/backward displacement.
defectsAndDepartures: Outer allGroups loop calls a routine whose group argument is unused; that routine scans allUnits. Work repeats for every mounted group every0.5s.
sleep0.5 is inside the enabled branch; disabled while-true has no sleep. Do not import.
No local/player/remote/specialist/mission-order/fire-policy ownership guards before movement or fire. Delayed workers do not revalidate authority.
Cover is a random terrain object20m away with0.6m offset, not a hull-safe screened firing position; bush/fence/tree need not protect armour.

ATGM classification uses display/class-name substrings and whole-vehicle ammo; wrong station, target suitability and loaded-muzzle readiness are not established. selectRandom can receive empty ATGM list.
Uses exact live target pose/velocity and reveal; fixed one-second lead and ASL watch are not justified native believed-position fire control.
Unconditional forceSpeed-1 on no/dead target can overwrite another controller. Farther branch calls cover even when cover setting is false.

Counts requested fire cycles rather than actual shots; relocation marker cleared immediately because arrival wait is commented out. Retreat can overlap other movement and is not threat/hull/path validated.
CBEComparison: Current GroundFireReady evaluates actual selected gunner station, loaded damaging ammunition and target suitability, with qualified-muzzle acknowledgement at direct-fire issue. This is code evidence, not actual effect.
Current vehicle danger/routine suppression retains native belief and fire policy; new danger correction passed1477 existing tests/full build and independent package verification.

Smoke and finite retreat/combined manoeuvre paths already exist; inspect their actual selection and authority before adopting smoke-and-relocate intent. Cover exposure evaluation and suitable ATGM selection require further comparison.
sourceReview.licence: Still unverified; no code copied into product.

findings: CBE discovers countermeasures by cmlauncher config plus compatible positive-round inventory on the exact turret, including driver and person turrets; no name-only smoke lookup.
Danger smoke has a separate generation receipt so gunner response does not consume its chance. No automatic movement is introduced by the helper.

Damaged/weapon-disabled mounted vehicle withdrawal requires an admitted avenue, ownership lease and accepted operation; reverse or tagged waypoint receipt controls transition into RETREAT. This is not proof of physical travel.
Source random cover offset, repeated free movement and blanket forceSpeed restoration are deliberately rejected; screened/hull-safe firing relocation remains separate work.
Countermeasure helper now reads magazinesAllTurrets once per request rather than once per scanned turret; no persistent cache.
smokeWithdrawalComparison.validation: 607 existing operation tests pass; full checkpoint build pending for snapshot optimization. Earlier danger suppression full1477 and package verification remain valid only for their previous candidate.
limits: BIS_fnc_fire dispatch is not proof of actual fire; verify Fired evidence later.
No measured runtime speedup or physical smoke/withdrawal acceptance.

crewedCountermeasureIntegration.sourceEvidence: Preserved fn_armored_force.sqf smoke branch resolves turretUnit and requires a living operator before launcher selection. Reverified extract SHA256 f0b14982dca5aa4a574520ddf287730ec26f12a1bd8b571f6eccab106a087355. Primary turretUnit documentation confirms driver path[-1] support: https://community.bistudio.com/wiki/turretUnit .
crewedCountermeasureIntegration.finding: CBE countermeasure helper selected configuration/ammunition by turret but did not validate station occupancy or its operator. An empty/changed/protected station could be the chosen firing request.
crewedCountermeasureIntegration.implementation: Resolve local occupied station, locate compatible cmlauncher/ammunition, then require combat-effective nonplayer operator, protected task availability and shared group exclusions with internal CBE feature ownership allowed. Recheck exact operator/turret and weapon membership at dispatch in existing native-call path. Do not assign crew or change ROE/skills/movement.
crewedCountermeasureIntegration.balanceAndCost: Preserve driver-first/modded turret selection and one live magazine snapshot. Full ownership checks only for stations with suitable launcher/ammo, repeated for selected station at dispatch. No world scan, worker or cooldown change. Added actor/group checks are unmeasured.
crewedCountermeasureIntegration.limits: Compatible available magazine inventory is not loaded-muzzle readiness or actual fire. BIS_fnc_fire remains a dispatch; source page direct403 and no downstream implementation/quiescence claim. Actual ground smoke/air flare/projectile effects and physical owner changes unverified. Not a complete armour implementation or parity claim.

dualRoleAmmunitionComparison.finding: Loaded legacy ground suitability rejected airLock1 as if air-only; reserve selection rejected it even with explicit ground target-use flags. Loaded explicit flags also bypassed air-only category rejection.
dualRoleAmmunitionComparison.implementation: GroundFireReady rejects airLock2 for known ground targets before preference flags, admits dual-role1 through existing damaging-ammo/target/warhead and exact loaded-muzzle checks. GroundReload excludes2 rather than every positive value, preserving its existing laserLock/LaserSensorComponent exclusions and unambiguous exact-turret reserve policy.
dualRoleAmmunitionComparison.limits: No general ATGM guidance implementation or native lock claim. No synthetic reveal/lock, projectile steering, new ammunition or firing worker. Range, guidance, physical switching/fire/effect and runtime cost remain unverified. Existing ammo preference heuristics remain.
dualRoleAmmunitionComparison.cost: One scalar native config read reused per loaded-state target evaluation; no new state query, world scan, worker or cadence. Reserve scan bounds unchanged.

withdrawalRecoveryComparison.finding: CortexVehicles initial escape calls CortexSelectAvenue VEHICLE. Shared GroupTick RETREAT retry called default INFANTRY and selected an unchecked raw candidate without a threat position; rejected vehicle terrain could be admitted after a stall.
withdrawalRecoveryComparison.implementation: Carry VEHICLE_WITHDRAW mobility into bounded retry selector. No threat position refuses unvalidated vehicle fallback; infantry fallback retained. Failed planning still consumes one of original four retries, same deadline and owner operation.
withdrawalRecoveryComparison.sourceDisposition: Protocol random terrain-object offset and free delayed doMove do not establish hull-safe cover or arrival. Keep useful smoke/withdrawal intent within current CBE operation and shared validated route selection; do not copy these shortcuts.
withdrawalRecoveryComparison.cost: Same four candidates and selector sample caps; no additional geometry pass, query worker or timer. Vehicle terrain thresholds stricter, native terrain outcomes/performance unverified.
withdrawalRecoveryComparison.validation: Existing609 operation tests and full1482/HEMTT/SQF/config/FSM/docs/package passed; independent verify passed. vehicleEndpointScreening.finding: Existing vehicle escape/AA planning passed VEHICLE terrain mode but screening rays used infantry1m samples along the route. Narrow/low objects could earn preference without testing the vehicle endpoint envelope.
vehicleEndpointScreening.implementation: Optional platform argument in shared SelectAvenue. Derive conservative horizontal radius from model bounds and uniform render scale, upper sample height from full model height. Replace three route sample locations with endpoint left/centre/right at that height, ignoring own platform. All3 require hard screening before any cover bonus; no concealment/partial credit. Unknown/nonpositive or radius>30m/height>20m geometry gets no screening credit; terrain-only escape remains possible.
vehicleEndpointScreening.integration: CortexVehicles withdrawal/standoff, shared RETREAT vehicle retry and CortexAARelocate supply actual platform. Other callers retain default route screening. No extra movement owner or new command/worker/cache.
vehicleEndpointScreening.cost: One boundingBoxReal/getObjectScale observation per plan. At most3 COVER helper calls per route leg replacing previous3 COVER plus up to3 CONCEALMENT calls. Terrain samples and candidate caps unchanged. Cost unmeasured.
vehicleEndpointScreening.limits: Sparse upper-envelope observations are not full hull protection, occupancy clearance, vehicle future tilt/heading prediction or firing-position/guidance proof. Scaled active vehicle physics and nonuniform scaling remain unsupported engine concerns; getObjectScale is render scale, not collision proof. Actual native driving/cover/performance unverified.
vehicleEndpointScreening.primarySemantics: https://community.bohemia.net/wiki/getObjectScale : render scale relative to model; indexed documentation retrieved2026-10-21. No claim of collision scaling.
vehicleEndpointScreening.validation: All1482/full HEMTT/SQF/config/FSM/docs/package passed; independent verify passed. vehicleHornClassification20261021.scope: Original CBE shared vehicle-classification defect found during armoured-force integration trace. No new upstream source reviewed or copied in this change.
vehicleHornClassification20261021.finding: Danger profile, jink admission and lost-gun withdrawal identified horns using lowercased English displayName. Translated/custom horn labels could classify an otherwise unarmed transport as armed; two simulation comparisons were also case-sensitive.
vehicleHornClassification20261021.implementation: All three existing live turret predicates exclude CarHorn config inheritance plus case-normalised carhorn/cmlauncher simulation. No cached platform result, extra worker, world scan or fire/movement command.
vehicleHornClassification20261021.evidence: Official Arma3 CfgWeapons Vehicle Weapons lists CarHorn and other horn entries: https://community.bistudio.com/wiki/Arma_3:_CfgWeapons_Vehicle_Weapons . Config identity is separate from presentation; simulation fallback also covers non-derived horn implementations.
vehicleHornClassification20261021.limits: Horn/CM utility exclusion only; not a complete classifier for every modded utility weapon, loaded ammunition, station availability or firing readiness. Dynamic loadout/localisation/physical behaviour and performance unverified. No parity or score change.

jinkCrewOwnership20261021.finding: Jink admission checked driver protected tasks only; a separate effective commander could have care/native/specialist ownership. Active jink route retention did not bind control-seat identity or recheck those tasks.
jinkCrewOwnership20261021.implementation: Read-only CortexVehicleCrewAvailable checks exact required driver/commander pair, <=2 unique actors, local/group/control/simulation/health/MOVE/PATH/care/native task/reservation/fleeing/external platform and actor guards. Used before planning admission, after geometry and after OperationStart before GroupMove. Operation stores vehicle/control-seat binding. Existing CortexVehicles lifecycle cancels exact jink generation on missing/changed/protected seats, retiring owned temporary waypoint without replacement movement. No new timer/scan or altered reverse/route ownership contract.

jinkLocalityTrace20261021.uncertainty: Does new exact seat proof need extra public transmission or seat reconstruction for jink migration?
executionTrace: OperationStart establishes owner epoch before publishing new operation, avoiding first-adoption cancellation of its own new start.

CortexLocality cancels old common operation as OWNERSHIP_LOST before epoch-bound state/durable intent reconstruction. Real transfer clears old local tactical state; original jink is not a durable resumption branch.
CortexCheckpoint whitelist does not serialize movementLease/vehicleDangerJink. Dedicated withdrawal has a separate authored-order/deadline resumption contract; it does not imply jink replay.
Normal CortexGroupTick services existing vehicle lifecycle before general movement processing; seat/task cancellation does not depend on later active contact admission.
jinkLocalityTrace20261021.decision: No product change. Do not broadcast a new replay token, reconstruct old jink permission from current seats, or add a second handover controller. Current exact seat binding is local continuation authority; owner change retires transient work.
jinkLocalityTrace20261021.validation: Three existing focused locality/jink regressions passed. No unchanged full build repeated; existing sealed candidate unchanged.
jinkLocalityTrace20261021.limits: Source/static ordering only. Vehicle/group split-locality, timing, mission-route continuation and HC transfer physically unverified; no completed handover claim.

groundWeaponIntentTrace20261021.sourceScope: fn_armored_force lines77..144 and281..357 inspected for magazine/name classification, ATGM fire requests, exact target lead/reveal and relocation admission; not a new whole-file review. Current CBE readiness/selection headers, actual station/muzzle evaluation and reserve load admission/pending/candidate/commit portions traced.
groundWeaponIntentTrace20261021.sourceFindings: ATGM identity relies on weapon/magazine names and whole-vehicle ammo. Requests ATGM and first weapon fire without exact selected-muzzle qualification. Counts requests and can start relocation without demonstrated shots or arrival. Exact live target pose/velocity, reveal and fixed lead are not justified by belief-only fire control.
groundWeaponIntentTrace20261021.currentImplementation: CBE reads selected native gunner station, <=16 weapons/8 muzzles each/32 state queries; only loaded damaging target-suitable rounds qualify. Exact requested muzzle rechecked before selection. Reserve loading uses actual station inventory/compatible muzzle, original native order/target/contact stamp/opportunity and finite native completion observation; no delayed fire from READY. Existing suppression requires loaded nonexplosive bullet policy.
groundWeaponIntentTrace20261021.decision: No second utility/combat classifier, name-based ATGM heuristic, fixed target lead, extra watcher or speculative firing change. Existing role-specific readiness is stronger than whole-vehicle weapon presence; horn classification remains domain admission rather than firing proof.
groundWeaponIntentTrace20261021.validation: Four existing focused loaded-station/reserve/suppression regressions passed. No product change, unchanged full build not repeated.
groundWeaponIntentTrace20261021.limits: Not native guided-lock/terminal effect or whole Protocol armour parity. Actual muzzle selection, reload timing, fired shots, hit/effect, varied mod loadouts, owner migration, balance and runtime performance remain unverified. No score changes.

vehicleFeatureRetirement20261021.finding: Existing lifecycle-only vehicle service ran before contact/admission returns but did not close active manoeuvre ownership when its enable gate closed. Jink/orientation/withdrawal/standoff could therefore remain active until original movement deadline.
vehicleFeatureRetirement20261021.implementation: Same lifecycle callback reads master Vehicles plus owning feature: Jink, Withdraw, or Gunnery for orientation/standoff. Closed gate forces inactive status and cancels exact operation generation as FEATURE_DISABLED before arrival evaluation. Existing exact route/reverse/turn retirement runs; no replacement manoeuvre, extra worker, timer or new CBA setting.
vehicleFeatureRetirement20261021.cost: Two existing feature-gate reads per active vehicle operation service; no roster/world scan or geometry added. Runtime performance unmeasured.
vehicleFeatureRetirement20261021.limits: Static lifecycle gating only. Physical turn cessation/reverse quiescence/native travel/normal-HC/settings interruption latency and measured budget unverified. No upstream source/parity/score claim.
